Your roses

Rose types, graded for your market

Every stem is graded by length, bud size and color consistency before it leaves the farm. Here's what we grow and export most.

Hybrid Tea Roses

Classic single-bloom stems with a high, pointed bud — the global standard for bouquets and single-stem sales.

Stem: 40–70cmGrade: A / A+

Spray (Cluster) Roses

Multiple small blooms per stem, ideal for filler work and mixed arrangements with a fuller look.

Stem: 35–55cmGrade: A

Garden (Premium) Roses

Densely-petalled, ruffled blooms with a romantic, vintage look — a favourite for luxury florists.

Stem: 45–65cmGrade: A+

Sweetheart Roses

Petite, compact buds on slender stems — popular for boutonnieres and delicate corsage work.

Stem: 25–40cmGrade: A / B

Airfreight

How airfreight keeps your flowers fresh

Every export order moves through a tightly scheduled airfreight process built around one goal: shortening the time between harvest and your doorstep, without ever breaking the cold chain.

01

Cargo Booking

We reserve temperature-controlled cargo space on scheduled flights, timed to match your harvest and grading window — not the other way round.

02

Pre-Cooling & Palletizing

Stems are pre-cooled to 2–4°C, boxed, and built into IATA-approved cargo pallets sized for the aircraft's hold.

03

Customs & Phytosanitary Clearance

Export permits, phytosanitary certificates and customs paperwork are cleared before the shipment ever reaches the tarmac.

04

Temperature-Controlled Hold

Pallets are loaded into a climate-controlled cargo hold, keeping stems cool and humid for the full duration of the flight.

05

Transit & Tracking

Shipments are tracked from wheels-up to touchdown, so you always know exactly where your order is en route.

06

Arrival & Last-Mile Delivery

On landing, cargo clears destination customs and moves out in refrigerated trucks straight to your warehouse or auction floor.

2–4°CCargo Hold Temp
85–90%Relative Humidity
<30hFarm to Door
24/7Shipment Tracking
About us

Built for one job: keeping flowers fresh across distance.

BLOOMAIR Exports and Logistics started as a small pack-house serving three local farms. Today we coordinate harvesting, grading, cold storage and airfreight for growers who need their roses to reach florists and wholesalers overseas without losing a single hour of vase life.

We handle the logistics so growers can focus on growing, and buyers can trust every box that lands.

Cold Chain

Unbroken 2–4°C chain from harvest to hangar.

Certified

Phytosanitary & export compliance on every shipment.

On Time

Flight-slot booking built around bloom, not backlog.
